scope.summary: Emit the corrective/driver sidecar with every skeletal export per Section 13.26 (Part-3 contract, GREQ-026): baked pose-space-named JCM blendshapes (jcm_thigh_fwd_90_l) plus the machine-readable driver sidecar JSON (bone channel -> morph curve) from MT-535, and package the MT-536 generator scripts (Blender shape-key drivers, UE Pose Driver setup) into the export bundle.
acceptance_criteria: Every skeletal export (glTF and FBX-bridge lanes) includes the baked corrective blendshapes selected for the current body with pose-space names following the jcm_<bone>_<motion>_<angle>_<side> convention.
The driver sidecar JSON (versioned schema) maps each corrective to its driving bone channel and response curve; the sidecar validates against its schema in CI.
The export bundle packages the Blender shape-key-driver generator addon script and the UE Pose Driver (RBF) setup script, each pinned to the sidecar schema version they consume.

Round-trip proof: running the Blender generator in headless Blender on a sample export reproduces driver behavior — posing the thigh to 90 degrees activates the corresponding baked corrective within tolerance (the Diffeo Auto-JCM precedent, automated).
scope.risk_if_missed: Correctives die at the export boundary exactly like Daz's ERC links die in FBX — bodies bend beautifully in Handshake and collapse at the knees in Blender/UE, failing the round-trip acceptance bar.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
